'''Quesh Control''' was a organization of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] that commanded [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial forces]] on [[Quesh]] during the [[Galactic War]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Quesh Control is mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Imperial Agent class mission on Quesh.<ref name="SWTOR" />
